policy: Future engineering dual-one-percent acceptance trains one zcp-selected architecture under two protocols.
required_runs: full data times at least one percent of the formal epoch schedule
exactly one percent data times the complete formal epoch schedule
rationale: Short training validates implementation and recovery but cannot reliably establish ZCP search gain. Training three candidates approximately triples GPU cost without providing a sufficiently converged or multi-seed comparison.
scientific_boundary: Claims that ZCP selection outperforms random or resource baselines require a separate predeclared, sufficiently trained, multi-seed research experiment.
historical_results: Completed and already-running immutable three-candidate runs remain unchanged and may finish naturally; they do not define the future engineering gate.
